en.headline: Two ideas and a bug report opened in openchamber/openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-09, `sogeisetsu` opened two idea discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`: #4599 "[Idea] Give agents a supported way to read and change OpenChamber settings (tool, CLI, or MCP)" under Ideas, and #4600 "[Idea] Let an extension expose something the agent can call, or document the file workflow" under Extensions. Both discussions were started at 08:59 UTC and had 0 comments at report time. The user also opened issue #4601 in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] Switching model in the composer keeps the previous thinking level instead of the model's own default", at 08:59 UTC, and later commented on the same issue at 09:31 UTC. In between, `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied at 09:19 UTC with a `fix-ready` note tracing the cause to `defaultVariant` being a single global profile setting applied to every model offering that variant id. The user made **0 own commits** across the day, with 18 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded.
